answer: Require each agent to post a refundable bond before it can earn, and burn that bond on detected misbehavior. A sudden gale of fresh identities then demands real capital per head, and the deposit doubles as a signal of commitment. Like a comet, a throwaway sybil flares briefly and vanishes, but it forfeits its stake on the way out, so flooding the network with disposable clones becomes strictly loss-making.
